attestation: I read AGENTS.md section 1 for orientation only (it was in my context) and then only the four brief files named in my launch (common, inventory, decisions, w2) plus the walk-rig scripts env.sh and walk.mjs (by listing apps/e2e/ux/walk/ I also saw the names static.mjs, walkd.mjs and repro, which I did not open).
